description: Makes the app's server, the server side of its web app. cloud: ploa (on Pro and Team: made at once with the room the plan gives each app; nothing is bought) or own (the person's Google Cloud project, any plan: Ploa prints commands they run once to let it in). Ask the person which before calling. retry: true carries on making one that stopped (after the person ran the commands, say). folder and releaseCommand set where the server's code is in the repository and a command run before each version goes live (database migrations, say: npx prisma migrate deploy).

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

folder.description: The server's folder in the repository, such as server or apps/api.

project.description: For cloud: own, the Google Cloud project's ID (Settings › Builds' when not given).

region.description: For cloud: own (me-west1, Tel Aviv, when not given).

releaseCommand.description: Run once before each version goes live; null for none.

name: ploa_server_create
title: Make the app's server
